name: Shocksquatch
abilities: Bio-electrokinesis - high-voltage bolts from body bolts or mouth, beams that travel along the ground
Static charge-up for a massive discharge on touch (can transfer charge to allies like Cannonbolt)
Electric force fields that fire beams in all directions
Enhanced strength (punched Buglizard through the ground into the subway)
Enhanced durability, jumping and speed (keeps pace with a car; runs on all fours)
summary: An electric yeti who spits and punches lightning; introduced in the Generator Rex crossover and redesigned as a yellow sasquatch for Omniverse.
traits: Debuted in Ben 10/Generator Rex: Heroes United
Unlocked accidentally by Rex trying to 'cure' Ben
Redesigned from white yeti to yellow-and-black sasquatch
notableFeats: Fought Alpha as Alpha-Arms in his debut (Ben 10/Generator Rex: Heroes United)
Defeated Buglizard (The More Things Change: Part 2)
Defeated Sunder (Have I Got a Deal for You)
Fought Argost's Frankencryptids with the Secret Saturdays (T.G.I.S.)
Defeated Negative Ultimate Echo Echo (The Ultimate Heist)

appearances.designNotes: Thick muscular yeti with white/grey/blue fur, reddish-pink face with pointed brows, green eyes with pupils, metal bolts on the backs of his hands and lower jaw; Ultimatrix symbol on chest. Only UA-era appearance is the Generator Rex crossover.

image.label: HU
image.notes: Transparent full-body render of the Heroes United (UA-era) design from the HU online game; low resolution (206×310) but clean and correct. Verified 2026-08-17.

notableEpisodes: Have I Got a Deal for You
appearances.designNotes: Slimmer yellow-and-black sasquatch, grey four-fingered hands and toes, bolts on the sides of his wrists, yellow lightning-bolt horns, green eyes; green/white belt with the Omnitrix on it.

scoring.rationale: Solid mid-tier: strong enough to punch Buglizard through a street, with electric bolts, ground-travelling beams and shielding fields that beat Sunder and Negative Ultimate Echo Echo. Insulation, foam and energy-drainers switch him off, and he loses to heavier hitters (Looma, Way Bad).

notes: Debut is the Generator Rex crossover Heroes United (Generator Rex season 3), a UA-era story with the Ultimatrix; treated as series 'ua'.
UA wearer: Ultimatrix; OV: new Omnitrix.
